name: Barbell Incline Scapular Press
steps: Set an adjustable bench to roughly a 45-degree incline, sit back with feet planted, and hold a barbell over your shoulders with locked arms.
Steady the bar over your shoulders and keep your ribs against the pad.
Push the bar smoothly upward a few inches by spreading your shoulder blades forward around your rib cage.
Allow your shoulder blades to glide slowly back against the bench without bending your elbows.
tips: Hold the same elbow angle as your shoulder blades glide.
Avoid shrugging your shoulders toward your ears as you press the bar higher.
